description: This file defines a Java interface named ContentWorkerInterface within the package org.apache.ofbiz.widget.content. The interface declares methods related to content retrieval and rendering, used in the OFBiz content management framework.

classes.name: ContentWorkerInterface
classes.description: A Java interface providing method signatures for content retrieval and rendering within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: getCurrentContentExt
methods.description: Retrieves the current extended content based on various parameters, throwing GeneralException if an error occurs.

methods.name: getWebSitePublishPointExt
methods.description: Fetches the website publish point for a given content ID, potentially throwing a GenericEntityException.

methods.name: getMimeTypeIdExt
methods.description: Determines the MIME type ID for a given content view within a specific context.

methods.name: renderContentAsTextExt
methods.description: Renders content identified by contentId into an Appendable output stream, considering the locale, MIME type, and cache options.

methods.name: renderContentAsTextExt
methods.description: Returns the rendered content as a String instead of writing directly to an output stream.

methods.name: renderSubContentAsTextExt
methods.description: Renders a sub-content identified by mapKey for a given contentId into an Appendable stream.

methods.name: renderSubContentAsTextExt
methods.description: Returns the rendered sub-content as a String.
